title: Tiny Emulators
summary: Tiny Emulators is a collection of lightweight, single-file emulators for classic 8-bit systems (NES, Game Boy, C64, VIC-20, Apple II, ZX Spectrum, Atari 2600, etc.) that can run directly in the browser. The project provides both JavaScript versions for web embedding and C versions for native compilation.
problem_solved: Makes retro gaming emulation lightweight and easily embeddable for web and native applications without heavy dependencies.
why_valuable: Provides portable, self-contained emulators in single files that developers can easily integrate into websites or applications.
